args.body: Hi Dora! Thanks for sharing your website (www.dora-website.com). Here's my feedback: it's nice and concise — you get straight to the point, and it's great that you included your email address so people can easily reach you. My one suggestion would be to add a bit more personality: a sentence or two about who you are, what you do, and your interests or hobbies. Right now it reads as a single line, so a visitor would love a little more to learn about you. Also, consider adding a photo or links to your social profiles. Overall, a clean start — just give people a bit more to connect with!

Hi Eve! I took a look at your blog (www.eve-blog.com). Feedback: I love that it's focused — telling visitors your favorite hobby is hiking gives it an immediate, personal touch, which is exactly what a blog should do. My suggestion would be to build on that: post about your actual hikes (favorite trails, photos, recent trips) so the blog feels alive and gives readers a reason to come back. As with Dora's site, adding a photo and links to your other profiles would help too. Great foundation — now let your hiking stories fill it out!
